kind: verified canonical hexahedral boundary traversal: equivalent-output CPU and allocation diagnostic
methodology: Identical release source and exact dependency lock, with isolated baseline/candidate timing/allocation targets. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice supplies four fresh processes/version, one warmup plus five samples/case; separate allocation builds. No task-owned builds/checks/tests ran during timing. Checked aggregate CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID. Grids 8/24/48 cubed, 128-square opaque scene frames: point, uniform/varying/missing cell fields, plus a nearly canonical grid whose last cell is rotated and must fall back; extra 24-cubed varying-cell wire case. 64 scene cases/version. Cold preparation uses fresh Scene/cache but shared canonical Actor source; checks/destruction outside timing. Warm software/upload/submission reuses one geometry preparation. GPU upload times public buffer/LUT/uniform allocation/upload submission, with renderer initialized. Resident submit times public encode/uniform/queue-submit CPU, excludes GPU completion/readback checks and waits after each sample. No first-use, GPU execution latency/throughput, power or peak/live/RSS/VRAM claim. Eight extra mesh cases at 8/24/48/96 cubed: boundary_triangles returns a vector whose ordered node-ID hash is checked outside timing; owned_chunk_visit uses a prevalidated snapshot, 4096-triangle chunks and a callback hashing exact source-cell IDs and ordered global node IDs during timing, retaining only count/hash. Canonical connectivity verification remains inside each measured traversal, while initial validation for the visitor is excluded. Scene cold preparation includes its validation. All cross-version image/output hashes and retained payload lengths must match exactly. Payload means retained derived CPU scene geometry, actual GPU geometry buffers, vector triangle length times 12, or zero retained output for the visitor, according to case. Source arrays, metadata/capacity, target/LUT/uniform/pipeline state and allocator overhead excluded. Rust allocated bytes include positive realloc growth, exclude all resized-buffer traffic and do not measure peak/live memory or GPU/native allocations. General noncanonical topology still uses the global face map; canonical face discovery uses fixed cursors after an O(cell_count) connectivity proof. Host thermal/affinity state uncontrolled
